events.did: Sat slumped in one of his office chairs with a cold cloth pressed against his eyes, trying again and again to convert the EOs from violent prisoners to pliant patients
events.quote_anchor: Instead, he was slumped in one of the two chairs, his legs up on the table and his head tipped back, a cold cloth pressed against his eyes.

events.did: Told the recorder on his table, with Helena Roy seated opposite, that converting the EOs was not working
events.quote_anchor: “It isn’t working,” he said, addressing the recorder on the table as much as Helena, who sat placid in the opposite chair.

events.did: Concluded that converted humans became blank slates while the EOs kept their minds, personalities, histories and grievances
events.quote_anchor: But EOs, for whatever reason, appeared to retain their minds as well as their memories. Their personalities, and histories, and grievances.

events.did: Pulled his last three subjects from the morgue instead of the inmate catalogue to soften their rigidity toward EON, and found only two conscious and both stubbornly defiant
events.quote_anchor: In an attempt to circumnavigate this hurdle, he’d pulled his last three subjects not from the present catalogue of inmates, but from the morgue

events.did: Decided he needed an EO who had never seen him or EON as an enemy
events.quote_anchor: He needed an EO who had never seen him—or EON—as an enemy.

events.did: Asked where Rios was, learned Agent Harris had just returned to base, and called him in
events.quote_anchor: He was about to order her called back when the former director added that Agent Harris had just returned to base.

events.did: Told Gabriel he had turned himself in because he wanted to make it right
events.quote_anchor: “I wanted…” Noah looked down at his hands, as if searching for the words. “I wanted to make it right.”

events.did: Raised a gun behind Noah Harris’s back and shot him after he told Gabriel he trusted him
events.quote_anchor: The soldier nodded. “Yes, sir,” he said, right before the shot went off.

relations.did: Is a converted human whom Gabriel has reduced to a sounding board after regretting converting her
relations.quote_anchor: Instead, he had reduced her to a sounding board.

relations.did: Is one of the two EOs the late Director Stell tapped to serve EON, and both were ex-military
relations.quote_anchor: It made sense, thought Gabriel, that the two EOs the late Director Stell had tapped to serve EON were both ex-military.

relations.did: Carries survivor’s guilt over his black ops team and the fact that he was the only one who made it out alive
relations.quote_anchor: Survivor’s guilt hung like a lead weight around his shoulders, even though he bore it well.

relations.did: Is the EO agent Gabriel interviewed on his first day, a soldier who served by choice, and was still on mission
relations.quote_anchor: remembering the EO agent he’d interviewed on his first day, the soldier who served by choice
